$comment: Icons that mirror in right-to-left text, read by scripts/generate.mjs: each component carries data-area-rtl="mirror" and @area/icons/rtl.css flips it under :dir(rtl). Rule (docs/specs/icons.md, "Accessible name and right-to-left"): a concept tied to reading direction mirrors when Fluent's React icons (directionType mirror, microsoft/fluentui-system-icons@f126001) or Google's Material list (google/material-design-icons@6eed39a, index.html 496-525) mirror its counterpart, and the family shares it. Never: icons named for a literal direction (arrow-left, chevron-right: the caller picks by meaning), circular arrows and clocks (they turn clockwise in every script), slashes, checkmarks, digits and letters, real objects, and drawings that are symmetric already (import, list, screen-share).

mirror.undo: back in reading order; Fluent and Material
mirror.redo: forward in reading order; Fluent and Material
mirror.list-bullet: markers at the line start; Material format_list_bulleted
mirror.list-collapse: markers at the line start, list-bullet's family
mirror.list-tree: hierarchy indents from the line start
mirror.table-of-contents: text with its markers at the line end; Material toc
mirror.star-half: fills from the start side; Material star_half
mirror.backspace: deletes toward the start; Material backspace
mirror.chevron-first: the start, not the left; Material first_page
mirror.chevron-last: the end, not the right; Material last_page
mirror.trending-up: time runs in reading order; Fluent and Material
mirror.trending-down: time runs in reading order; Fluent and Material
